text:
nina: follow-up from the KV-eviction postmortem 1 I want to convert the open remediations into scoped eval tickets and a drill schedule. quick owner check.

omar: i'll own the regression promptset + CI integration. target: 10 days. will cover seq-len edge cases + cache-warmup scenarios.

felix: i'll define the load profile and SLO table. 5 days to draft, then sync with SRE.

rachel: i'll build the chaos checklist and run staging dry-run. plan: staging dry-run in 12 days, prod drill in 20 days after approvals.

oncall-bot: incident recap: KV eviction burst 2026-03-05T14:12Z 1 elevated error-rate on small dedicated pool. postmortem: https://redwood-infra/incident/3267

nina: concrete deliverables we agreed on:
- tests/eviction/promptset.yaml (omar)
- tests/eviction/load_profile.json + slos.md (felix)
- runbooks/chaos/eviction_checklist.md (rachel)
- CI: nightly-targeted eval + post-merge smoke cron (ops)

omar: PR plan: add promptset, two regression scenarios, label `eviction` + `ci:nightly`. will reference the incident pattern in PR.

felix: SLO sketch: p95 latency <200ms under smoke; error-rate <1% baseline; eviction-related failures <5%. I'll put full thresholds in the ticket.

rachel: chaos checklist highlights: pre-check KV metrics, throttle network subset, inject memory pressure, run promptset 30m, capture traces, rollback if >5% uncaught errors for 10m.

nina: ownership recap for tracking sheet:
- Promptset + CI: omar (10d)
- Load profile + SLOs: felix (5d)
- Chaos runbook + staging dry-run: rachel (12d staging, 20d prod)

omar: will tag tests with `owner:omar` and `pattern:kv-eviction`. opening WIP PR today.

felix: can we add a tiny nightly smoke cron after merge? propose: `0 4 * * * eval-runner --suite eviction --smoke-only`. i'll file infra request if ok.

rachel: add me as approver for the chaos runbook PR. i'll prepare a 1-slide ops brief with rollback steps.

oncall-bot: reminder set: staging dry-run tentative 3489012400 (in ~12d).

nina: thanks all. i'll update the postmortem action table and create the remediation ticket with owners/timeboxes: https://docs.redwood/actions/kv-eviction-remediation-2026. we'll reconvene 48h before the dry-run to surface blockers.
